name: GPU Marching Cubes with Scan-Based Compaction
definition: A GPU-accelerated Marching Cubes pipeline that classifies voxels, uses exclusive prefix sums to count active voxels and required vertices, compacts the voxel index array to remove empty voxels, and extracts the isosurface only for active voxels.
summary: GPU Marching Cubes with Scan-Based Compaction extracts isosurfaces on the GPU using exclusive prefix sums to count and compact active voxels, avoiding buffer overflow and dynamic memory allocation.
